card.name: News agency names in datelines
card.fires_on: News wire names such as ANI, UPI or AP inside a dateline parentheses right after a city and date. Also weaker on editor-list initials and a few opening words like Note or Abstract.

modes.label: Wire dateline
modes.description: Agency abbreviation in parentheses after a place and date at the start of a news story.
modes.example: HEIDELBERG, Germany, Oct. 27 (<<UPI>>) -- German scientists say they've developed

modes.label: Citation initials
modes.description: Final initials of an author in a reference list before the eds. marker.
modes.example: Kasper DL, Braunwald E, Fauci AS, Hauser SL, Longo<< DL>>, Jameson JL, eds. Harrison

modes.label: Label opening
modes.description: A label word that opens a text block, such as Note or Abstract.
modes.example: Editor’s<< Note>>: David Wise is the author of numerous
